## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `CreateEvaluations`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `creating-evaluations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **CreateEvaluations**.

## Step 2: Start a new evaluation

1. <!-- manual: Open the Test Explorer by clicking the test beaker icon in the activity bar. -->
2. Select **Add AI Evaluation**.
3. <!-- manual: Fill the Create New AI Evaluation form and click Save. -->
